## What this region is

The email content models and their ownership: (a sendable message) and (a reusable MJML fragment marked inline), owned through false polymorphism and resolved by the tier cascade, with versions kept in the audit log and recomposed from snapshots. How content is composed, rendered, validated and saved is the region.

## What it exists for

- Save email templates and components with validation
- Resolve a template or component through the owner cascade
- Render an email for sending, previewing or reconstruction
- Validate an email template before saving or sending

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Send an email to the user → email-delivery
- Can this rule read that field → email-lens
- Notify these people by text → email-delivery
- Is this condition allowed in the template → email-lens
